idea-plugin.name: Easy AI Commit
idea-plugin.description:
Easy AI Commit is a simple, flexible AI-assisted commit message generator for JetBrains IDEs.

Existing plugins often support only OpenAI-style APIs, require complex setup, or do not allow custom prompts. Easy AI Commit removes those trade-offs with a focused one-click workflow.

Model connectivity

  • First-class support for both OpenAI Compatible and Anthropic Compatible protocols.
  • One Custom preset can use either protocol, making it suitable for compatible model providers, aggregation services, gateways, and proxies.
  • Named model profiles support custom Base URLs, model IDs, API keys, and connection testing, so multiple endpoints remain easy to configure and distinguish.

Provider presets

Includes 24 named presets with protocol-specific defaults for endpoints, models, and authentication:

  • OpenAI Compatible and Anthropic Compatible: DeepSeek, OpenRouter, GLM, Alibaba Bailian, Kimi, MiniMax, SiliconFlow, StepFun, and Tencent TokenHub.
  • OpenAI Compatible: OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, Volcano Ark, Baidu Qianfan, iFlytek Spark, Mistral AI, Groq, Together AI, Fireworks AI, Cerebras, Cohere, Perplexity, and Hugging Face.
  • Anthropic Compatible: Anthropic.

Commit message generation

  • Click the Easy AI Commit logo to generate from included changes, or from all displayed pending changes when nothing is included.
  • Generated text is written directly into the existing Commit Message editor.
  • Custom prompt templates and 18 selectable output languages are supported.
  • Auto output language follows the current IDE language.
  • API keys are stored securely with JetBrains Password Safe.
